info.name: Participium API Acceptance Tests
info.description: External API acceptance test suite for the Participium backend. Run against a local backend started from src/backend with default seed data. The suite uses API-visible session cookies only and stores generated resource ids in the environment.

item.name: Initialize run data and health check

exec: pm.test('service status is ok', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status', 'ok'); });

item.name: Reference data exposes roles and report statuses

exec: pm.test('reference data shape is valid', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.roles).to.be.an('array').that.includes('citizen').and.includes('operator').and.includes('admin'); pm.expect(j.report_statuses).to.be.an('array').that.includes('Pending Approval').and.includes('Assigned').and.includes('In Progress').and.includes('Resolved'); pm.expect(j.public_report_statuses).to.be.an('array').that.includes('Assigned').and.includes('Resolved'); });

pm.test('categories are active and have required fields', () => { const arr = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; arr.forEach(c => { pm.expect(c).to.include.keys('id','name','is_active'); pm.expect(c.id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(c.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(c.is_active).to.eql(true); }); const roads = arr.find(c => c.name === 'Roads and Urban Furniture') || arr[0]; pm.environment.set('category_id', String(roads.id)); });

pm.test('public report summaries have public-only statuses', () => { const arr = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr).to.be.an('array'); const allowed = ['Assigned','In Progress','Suspended','Resolved']; arr.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r).to.include.keys('id','title','category','status','is_public','reporter','photos'); pm.expect(allowed).to.include(r.status); pm.expect(r.is_public).to.eql(true); }); if (arr.length > 0) { pm.environment.set('public_report_id', String(arr[0].id)); } });

pm.test('public detail does not expose private messages to anonymous viewer', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.include.keys('id','status','status_history','can_access_messages'); pm.expect(j.can_access_messages).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.status_history).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Get current user without login is rejected

exec: function expectErrorShape() { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); pm.expect(j.error).to.be.a('string'); }
function expectErrorShape() { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('error'); pm.expect(j.error).to.be.a('string'); }

pm.test('registered user is citizen and not verified yet', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('user'); pm.expect(j.user.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('unique_email')); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('citizen'); pm.expect(j.user.is_email_verified).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.verification_url).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; const token = j.verification_url.split('/').pop(); pm.environment.set('verification_token', token); });

pm.test('user is now verified', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.include('Email verified'); pm.expect(j.user.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('unique_email')); pm.expect(j.user.is_email_verified).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('logged-in user is the unique citizen', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.include('Logged in'); pm.expect(j.user.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('unique_email')); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('citizen'); pm.environment.set('citizen_user_id', String(j.user.id)); });
pm.test('profile belongs to logged-in citizen', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('citizen_user_id'))); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('citizen'); });
pm.test('profile fields were updated', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.first_name).to.eql('AcceptanceUpdated'); pm.expect(j.email_notifications_enabled).to.eql(false); });

request.description: Requires Postman/Newman to access the relative file in the photo_path environment variable.

formdata.value: Report created by the Postman acceptance suite.

exec: pm.test('citizen can create a report', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('created report is pending and stored for later workflow', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.title).to.eql(pm.environment.get('unique_report_title')); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('Pending Approval'); pm.expect(j.is_anonymous).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.photos).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.environment.set('created_report_id', String(j.id)); });

item.name: List reports created by current citizen

exec: pm.test('created report appears in my reports', () => { const arr = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr).to.be.an('array'); const found = arr.find(r => String(r.id) === pm.environment.get('created_report_id')); pm.expect(found, 'created report exists in my reports').to.not.eql(undefined); });

item.name: Citizen can open own report detail and message area

exec: pm.test('report owner can access messages', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('created_report_id'))); pm.expect(j.can_access_messages).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.status_history).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });
pm.test('logged-in user is operator', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('operator'); });

pm.test('created report is visible to category operator', () => { const arr = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr).to.be.an('array'); const found = arr.find(r => String(r.id) === pm.environment.get('created_report_id')); pm.expect(found, 'created pending report is visible').to.not.eql(undefined); });
pm.test('report status becomes Assigned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('Assigned'); });

item.name: Move assigned report to In Progress

exec: pm.test('status history is returned as an array', () => {

pm.test('created report appears in assigned queue with unread count', () => { const arr = pm.response.json(); const found = arr.find(r => String(r.id) === pm.environment.get('created_report_id')); pm.expect(found).to.not.eql(undefined); pm.expect(found).to.have.property('unread_message_count'); });

pm.test('message shape is valid', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.report_id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('created_report_id'))); pm.expect(j.body).to.include('Operator message'); pm.expect(j.sender.role).to.eql('operator'); pm.environment.set('operator_message_id', String(j.id)); });

pm.test('operator message is visible to report owner', () => { const arr = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr).to.be.an('array'); const found = arr.find(m => String(m.id) === pm.environment.get('operator_message_id')); pm.expect(found).to.not.eql(undefined); });
pm.test('reply sender is citizen', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.sender.role).to.eql('citizen'); pm.expect(j.body).to.include('Citizen reply'); });

pm.test('report is followed by current user', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('is_followed_by_current_user'); pm.expect(j.is_followed_by_current_user).to.be.a('boolean'); });

pm.test('report is no longer followed', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('is_followed_by_current_user'); pm.expect(j.is_followed_by_current_user).to.be.a('boolean'); });
pm.test('users array contains roles', () => { const arr = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(arr.map(u => u.role)).to.include('admin'); });

pm.test('created category is active and stored', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql(pm.environment.get('unique_category_name')); pm.expect(j.is_active).to.eql(true); pm.environment.set('created_category_id', String(j.id)); });
pm.test('category is deactivated', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('created_category_id'))); pm.expect(j.is_active).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('created user has operator role', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('unique_operator_email')); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('operator'); pm.environment.set('admin_created_user_id', String(j.id)); });

pm.test('admin user update changed requested fields', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.first_name).to.eql('UpdatedGenerated'); pm.expect(j.email_notifications_enabled).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('admin stats response is an object', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('object'));
